records.part: Maintenance, calibration, repair, services, and parts for Target Systems, Target Control Systems, Bullet Traps, Baffles
records.reason: ACTION TARGET, INC. is the sole, exclusive, and certified provider of maintenance, calibration, repair, and services for ACTION TARGET manufactured equipment and the sole provider of parts, targets and supplies for ACTION TARGET manufactured equipment.
The College further understands that no other gun/firing range equipment company is contracted to sell these items as they are currently configured.
